notes: A page Firecrawl could not serve, reported INSIDE a 200 response: the transport succeeded, metadata.statusCode is the target's own status (404 here) and metadata.error carries the page's error note. The markdown carries the 404 page's own text, which is the point — a not-found page HAS a body, so without reading statusCode the model would be handed a 'Not Found' document as if it were the answer. Grounds the contract that an unservable page is an EMPTY result (walk continues, model is told nothing was retrieved), never a hard failure and never a bogus document.
